phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, own posture unknown but heavy tech/economy, opponent ground macro with light air.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent composition or pressure becomes clearer.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground, maintain defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology, strengthen ground forces, maintain defense.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech/Economy Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to production or expansion without confirming sufficient army strength and defense.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, own ground army with heavy production/tech, opponent ground with light air.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when map control or opponent intentions are clearer.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Stabilize, then increase production and maintain ground strength.
phase_policies.target: Stabilize then develop, increase production, maintain ground strength.
phase_policies.title: Early-Mid Stabilization
phase_policies.veto: Do not expand or tech without first stabilizing defenses and ensuring army strength.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, own ground army with heavy production/tech, opponent heavy ground with possible air.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or air presence changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Add air flexibility, strengthen ground, continue tech and production.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence, strengthen ground army, continue tech and production.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Strengthening
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground army strength while adding air flexibility.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, own heavy ground army, opponent heavy ground with possible air.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition is known.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Increase defense, continue tech, strengthen ground army.
phase_policies.target: Increase defense, continue tech, strengthen ground army.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Defense and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend economy or production without maintaining solid defense.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
